title: Travel Advisors w/ Own Client Base — IC or Merge
job_description:
Job Overview

Bring Your Clients. Keep Your Freedom. Upgrade Your Commission.

Dallas Travel, Inc. has been in business since 1975, under the same ownership since 1978 — 48 years of stability in this industry.

Here, you'll be appreciated, respected, and treated with genuine care — not just another commission split on a spreadsheet.

This posting is only for travel agents/advisors who already have their own book of business. If you don't have your own repeat clients, please don't apply — this is not an entry-level role and we are not training new agents.

We're looking for:

Salaried agents with a real following who are ready to become independent contractors
Current ICs who are unhappy with their commission split or support elsewhere
Small agency owners who'd rather merge into a larger operation and keep more of what they earn

To be considered, your application must include:

Years of experience as a travel advisor
Approximate size of your current client base
Your current employment status (salaried / IC / agency owner)

Applications without this information will not be reviewed.

What we offer:

Above-market commission splits
Marketing support through relationships with our other independent contractors
First-class back-up support from fellow ICs when you need coverage
A tight-knit team that's worked together for years. Even though we all work remotely, we communicate and support each other constantly — this isn't a group of strangers who happen to share a commission structure. We're looking for someone who genuinely fits with who we are, not just someone who fills a seat.

If you've built a following and want a partner that rewards it, tell us about your book of business.

Pay: $75,000.00 - $300,000.00 per year

Application Question(s):

Do you have your own repeat clients who would move with you to a new agency/IC arrangement? (Yes/No)
Approximately how many active clients do you currently serve (clients who have booked travel with you in the past 12 months)? Please answer with a number or range.
What is your current situation? (Salaried at an agency / Independent contractor / Small agency owner).
Do you currently have a non-compete or non-solicitation agreement with your current agency or employer? (Yes/No).
Briefly describe why you're considering a change (e.g., friendly work relationships, paid correctly and promptly, being appreciated both for my work and personally, commission split, support, autonomy, merger interest).

Experience:

of travel advisor : 5 years (Required)

Work Location: Remote
